test_title: PYST 20: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 13 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A shopkeeper expects a gain of 34% on his cost price. If, in a week, his sales proceeds were ₹3,417, what was his profit (in ₹)?
solution:
**Given:**

Sales proceeds = ₹3,417

Expected gain = 34%

**Formula Used:**

Profit = Sales proceeds - Cost price

Cost price = Sales proceeds / (1 + Gain/100)

**Calculation:**

Cost price = ₹3,417 / (1 + 34/100)

⇒ Cost price = ₹3,417 / (1 + 0.34)

⇒ Cost price = ₹3,417 / 1.34

⇒ Cost price = ₹2,550

Profit = Sales proceeds - Cost price

⇒ Profit = ₹3,417 - ₹2,550

⇒ Profit = ₹867

**The profit is ₹867.**
